class.name: FoxBoundedValue
class.brief_description: A resource that manages a [float] value within a defined minimum and maximum range.
class.description: Emits signals for overflow and underflow, allowing for secondary mechanics such as overkill or overhealing.

members.member: The maximum allowed value. Modifying this automatically clamps [member value].
The minimum allowed value. Modifying this automatically clamps [member value].
The current value. Automatically clamped between [member min_value] and [member max_value].

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member value], [member min_value], or [member max_value] changes.

signal.name: depleted
signal.description: Emitted when [member value] falls below [member min_value]. [param underflow] contains the absolute difference.

signal.name: saturated
signal.description: Emitted when [member value] exceeds [member max_value]. [param overflow] contains the absolute difference.
